title: Defining and Detecting Vulnerability in Human Evaluation Guidelines: A Preliminary Study Towards Reliable NLG Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Manual annotation of NLG human evaluation guidelines to identify instructions that unconsciously favor or disadvantage certain systems/results (e.g., presentation order bias, leading questions), followed by utilizing LLMs with various prompting strategies (Zero-shot, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought) to automatically detect these biased instructions.
